VEDPRAKASH DEWANGAN 2.
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of 19:26:21 +0530 regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 42 of 2023, registered at Police Station Bakawand, District Bastar,
Chhattisgarh for the offence under Section 376(3) of IPC and Section 06 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offices Act, 2012 (in short 'POCSO Act').

sentences.text: 1 and came back to her parents' house and lodged the report.
The applicant has been arrested on 05.10.2023 and charge-sheet has been filed.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that there is no legally admissible evidence with respect to the age of the victim.

She was a major girl having love affair with the applicant and resided with him without raising any objection and it is only when, his parents shown their disinterest, she lodged the report against the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 05.10.2023 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time, therefore, he may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents annexed with the application.

7. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of allegations and the material collected by the prosecution against the present applicant during investigation, further the fact that the victim was a major girl and having love affair with the applicant and she was resided in the house of the applicant for about a month without raising any objection, final adjudication of the case will take its own time, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
8. Consequently, the present application filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail is hereby allowed.

9. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court,
on following conditions:-
(i) He shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such fact to the Court.
(ii) He shall not act in any manner which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial.
(iii) He shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to him by the concerned trial Court till disposal of the trial.
